priorRejectedCandidate.reason: The 2026-09-24 candidate failed its frozen hot-p95 gate; no rejected parser code is included in this data-only experiment.

candidate.hypothesis: Adding the six independently reviewed Ruflo and RuVector records to the read-only provenance snapshot will improve held-out exact evidence retrieval from 1/6 to 6/6 while preserving all 48 prior records, default behavior and authority.
scope: reviewed upstream data and current source-head metadata
excluded: new vector, WASM, GNN or autonomous-learning functionality
the two newly reviewed Ruflo 3.45.0 records, which remain reviewed-not-incorporated for a separate bounded experiment
candidate.authority: read-only, offline, no new tool, resource, network, shell, write, credential or federation capability

groups: the snapshot contains 54 unique records, current pinned source heads, a fixed observation time and a new deterministic identity
honest learning-count reporting is exact-search retrievable and explicitly bounded to reporting integrity
the router benchmark is a negative result retaining 197 prompts, 113 held-out prompts, no winner and an unchanged default
durable intelligence save and graph-metadata round-trip evidence retain atomic, quarantine and reserved-key boundaries
quantize fail-closed and recursive WASM filter serialization retain unimplemented-writer and no-acceleration boundaries
all 48 prior records remain byte-canonical and ordered, least-privilege surfaces remain fixed, CLI retrieval works and the old snapshot fails closed

acceptance.heldOut: 6/6 and strictly better than the frozen 1/6 baseline; evaluator must not change after candidate scoring
acceptance.metaharness: metaharness@0.4.16, 6/6 hard constraints; heuristic status is not proof

performance.seedUsage: metadata only; fixed alternating order and no RNG
performance.workload: memory quantize graph metadata learning router
performance.measurementValidity: baseline hot p95 must be at least 0.01 ms; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE and no promotion

acceptance.package: normalized 94-entry dependency closure byte-identical, no new dependency, valid package, 18 files and compressed archive below 40000 bytes
acceptance.security: npm audit has no high/critical finding; pinned Ruflo code, dependency, secret and STRIDE scans complete with coverage limitations disclosed
acceptance.promotion: candidate bound to an exact commit, independent review, candidate CI, exact main-head recheck, fast-forward only and post-promotion CI

ruvectorWorkstream.decision: defer product vector retrieval, WASM acceleration and GNN learning below the frozen corpus gate
ruvectorWorkstream.futureMinimumGain: 10 percentage points held-out downstream task success

ruos.reason: The candidate changes reviewed local data only and does not affect a desktop journey, desktop control, MCP UI, OAuth or graphical performance.

forecast.prediction: Agent-memory and retrieval promotion suites will require state-conditioned, set-level evidence sufficiency, so individually relevant but collectively incomplete top-k results cannot pass.
forecast.falsifiableCriterion: At least two primary benchmarks or reviewed production harnesses first published or materially revised after 2026-09-25 must include grouped evidence requirements, a held-out split, an exact set-completeness or coverage metric and a downstream missing-group ablation; fewer than two falsifies the prediction.
